title: 🏆 Outstanding Student Supervision Award
summary: Dominique Makowski has won the University of Sussex School of Psychology's 2024 Award for Outstanding Student Supervision.
content: Dominique Makowski has won the University of Sussex School of Psychology's 2024 Award for Outstanding Student Supervision, presented by Professor Alison Pike, Head of the School of Psychology.

The certificate recognises him "for their outstanding contributions to the School of Psychology through exemplary teaching and dedicated support of students", and "their commitment to fostering a nurturing and intellectually stimulating environment".

That is the mentoring culture built at the Reality Bending Lab, where students are treated as collaborators from day one rather than pairs of hands: co-authorship, conference presentations and their own awards celebrating their achievements!
